# Scan 2 PDF

> Scan 2 PDF is a free, open-source Outlook add-in by Aghapy Tech Services that scans paper documents from a local scanner straight into the email being written, as one PDF or as JPEG images.

- Works in new Outlook for Windows, classic Outlook (Microsoft 365) and Outlook on the web.
- Scanning uses the free Scan 2 PDF Bridge app for Windows 10/11 (Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NNN9ZTWZ9TZ?cid=llms), which connects any scanner with a Windows (WIA) driver to the add-in. It runs only on the user's PC (127.0.0.1).
- Scan with phone: the add-in shows a QR code; the phone photographs pages in the browser (no app), straightens them and removes shadows, then sends them end-to-end encrypted to the Outlook panel. Works on Mac too.
- Get it: Microsoft Marketplace (Outlook add-ins store) https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/WA200013457 ; scanner bridge in the Microsoft Store https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NNN9ZTWZ9TZ
- Features: flatbed, document feeder and double-sided scanning; preview, rotate, reorder and remove pages; PDF or JPEG output; 150/200/300 dpi; color, grayscale or black and white; Letter, Legal and A4; add JPG/PNG images from file.
- Privacy: scanner pages go from the scanner into the user's email draft only. Phone pages are encrypted on the phone (AES-256-GCM, key never sent to the server) and deleted from the relay within 15 minutes. No account or tracking.
- License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/aghapytechservices/scan-2-pdf
